name: RTMP Livestream
summary: Stream video + audio to Twitch, YouTube, or any RTMP service. One destination per install — use SRT → Multi RTMP for parallel fan-out.

elements.name: voaacenc
elements.rationale: AAC audio encoder. Some distros ship it as a separate plugin pack.

elements.name: nvh264enc
elements.rationale: Hardware H.264 encoder on NVIDIA GPUs.

description: A simple template for going live. Picks a generated video source (so you can verify the pipeline works before pointing it at a real camera or screen), encodes with x264 + AAC, muxes to FLV, and pushes to an RTMP endpoint. Plug in your host + stream key after install. Designed as a starting point — once you've confirmed the connection works, swap the test source for a webcam, screen capture, or another media element.
